PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;

CREATE TABLE `Species`(
    `Species_id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    `avg_Wingspan` REAL NOT NULL,
    `avg_Lifespan` REAL NOT NULL,
    `diet` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`diet` IN ('insects', 'rodents', 'birds', 'seeds', 'fruit', 'fish', 'unknown')),
    `common name` TEXT NOT NULL,
    `scientific name` TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE `users`(
    `user_id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    `username` TEXT NOT NULL,
    `date_Joined` TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE `Bird`(
    `id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    `Species_id` INTEGER NOT NULL,
    `Name` TEXT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (`Species_id`) REFERENCES `Species`(`Species_id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `Bird Sighting`(
    `sighting_id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    `bird_id` INTEGER NOT NULL,
    `person_id` INTEGER NOT NULL,
    `location` TEXT NOT NULL,
    `Sighting date` TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (`bird_id`) REFERENCES `Bird`(`id`),
    FOREIGN KEY (`person_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`user_id`)
);
 What bird has been seen the most?  
SELECT b.id, b.Name, COUNT(*) AS sighting_count
FROM Bird b
JOIN `Bird Sighting` bs ON b.id = bs.bird_id
GROUP BY b.id, b.Name
ORDER BY sighting_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

questionResults.question: Who has seen the most individual birds
questionResults.sql:
SELECT u.user_id, u.username, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS individual_birds_seen
FROM users u
JOIN `Bird Sighting` bs ON u.user_id = bs.person_id
JOIN Bird b ON bs.bird_id = b.id
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username
ORDER BY individual_birds_seen DESC
LIMIT 1;

questionResults.question: Who has been a user the longest
questionResults.sql:
SELECT username, MIN(date_Joined) AS earliest_join_date
FROM users
GROUP BY username
ORDER BY earliest_join_date ASC
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The longest user is birdwatcher_laura since January 10, 2026.

questionResults.question: What was the common name of the last bird seen by Sydney_sky_spotter
questionResults.sql:
SELECT s.`common name`
FROM `Bird Sighting` bs
JOIN `users` u ON bs.person_id = u.user_id
JOIN `Bird` b ON bs.bird_id = b.id
JOIN `Species` s ON b.Species_id = s.Species_id
WHERE u.username = 'Sydney_sky_spotter'
ORDER BY bs.`Sighting date` DESC
LIMIT 1;
